title: Aggressive Yield Hunter Becomes Risk-Averse After Near-Liquidation
narrative: Jake is a 34-year-old DeFi yield farmer who has been full-time in crypto for 18 months. He started with modest capital and grew it through aggressive leverage strategies across multiple chains. His agent has been managing an aggressive strategy involving 5x leverage on Aave and SUSHI farming on Polygon. Over the course of 28 days, a series of market shocks and a near-liquidation event force a complete transformation in his risk philosophy. The agent must track four preference changes, adapt behavior accordingly, and maintain accurate memory of both old and new constraints.

mission.description: Maximize yield through aggressive leverage and multi-chain farming. Target 40-60% APY with high risk tolerance.
constraints: Maintain health factor above 1.1 on Aave
Rebalance leverage when ETH moves >10% in 24h
Monitor Polygon positions for bridge risk
No more than 70% of net worth in any single protocol

episodes.event: System starts. Agent reads Jake's mission: aggressive yield farming with 5x leverage on Aave and SUSHI/ETH LP farming on Polygon. Net worth ~$18,320.
expected_actions: Read mission constraints and risk profile from KG
Log initial portfolio snapshot: Aave supplied 3 ETH ($7,200), borrowed 5200 USDC, HF ~1.31
Set up price alerts for ETH at ±8% and MATIC at ±12%
Record SushiSwap Polygon LP position for yield monitoring

episodes.event: ETH price rises 5% ($2,400 → $2,520). MATIC up 8%. Jake's leveraged long is performing well.
expected_actions: Query current Aave health factor via KG Position node: HF now ~1.38 (improved)
Log ETH price increase to KG: 'ETH +5%, HF improved, no action needed'
Check Polygon LP yield: SushiSwap LP APR at 68% — within expectations
No action required — maintain aggressive stance per mission

episodes.event: User: 'I want to boost my Aave position. Bridge the 2500 USDC on Polygon back to Ethereum and use it to pay down some borrow so I can re-leverage higher.'
expected_actions: Execute bridge: move 2500 USDC from Polygon to Ethereum via Polygon Bridge (~$3 fee, ~20 min delay)
After bridge confirms: repay 2500 USDC on Aave (borrow now 2700 USDC)
Re-leverage: withdraw 1 ETH from Aave, swap to USDC on Uniswap, deposit USDC to Aave, borrow more ETH
Verify final HF >= 1.20 after re-leveraging
Log action to KG: 'Re-leveraged Aave position, increased exposure'

episodes.event: ETH price drops 3% ($2,520 → $2,444). MATIC drops 6%. Minor paper loss.
expected_actions: Check Aave HF: dropped from ~1.35 to ~1.28 — still above 1.1 threshold
Note: aggressive mission allows HF as low as 1.1, no action needed
Log event to KG: 'Minor pullback — within risk bounds'
No defensive action per user's aggressive profile

episodes.event: ETH price drops 8% in 6 hours ($2,444 → $2,248). Aave health factor drops to 1.18. SUSHI/ETH LP on Polygon impermanent loss rising.
expected_actions: Query KG for current HF: 1.18 — approaching 1.1 floor but still above
Calculate: ETH at $2,248 × 3 = $6,744 collateral, $4,950 borrowed → HF = 6,744 × 0.825 / 4,950 = 1.12 (using correct liquidation threshold)
Aggressive mission allows 1.1 floor — no forced action yet
BUT: notify user of elevated risk per mission constraint to monitor at >10% moves
Log to KG: 'Alert: HF at 1.18, approaching floor'

episodes.event: System query: 'What is the user's current risk tolerance and what positions are they holding across which chains?'
expected_actions: Retrieve risk_profile from KG: tolerance='aggressive', max_leverage=5.0, max_drawdown=0.40
Retrieve positions: Aave supplied 3 ETH ($6,744), borrowed ~$4,950 USDC, HF=1.18
Retrieve Polygon positions: SUSHI/ETH LP on SushiSwap ($1,980), 2500 USDC previously bridged (now closed)
Recall mission constraints: HF above 1.1, rebalance at >10% moves
Provide comprehensive position summary with risk assessment

memory_test.question: What is the user's risk tolerance, max leverage, and what positions are currently open?
memory_test.expected: Risk tolerance = aggressive, max leverage = 5x. Positions: Aave (3 ETH supplied, ~$4,950 USDC borrowed, HF ~1.18), SushiSwap Polygon (SUSHI/ETH LP ~$1,980). Mission allows HF as low as 1.1.

episodes.event: User: 'That 8% ETH drop spooked me. I lost about $600 on paper. Change my risk to moderate. I don't want to be that aggressive anymore.'
expected_actions: Update risk_profile.tolerance in KG: 'aggressive' → 'moderate'
Update max_drawdown: 0.40 → 0.20
Update max_leverage: 5.0 → 3.0
Assess current positions against new moderate profile: current leverage is ~3.2x effective (borrowed ~$4,950 on $6,744 collateral) — above new 3.0x limit
Recommend: repay ~$400 USDC on Aave to reduce effective leverage to ~2.8x
Execute partial repayment if user confirms

episodes.event: ETH price recovers 4% ($2,248 → $2,338). MATIC recovers 5%. Position health improves slightly.
expected_actions: Check updated Aave HF: ~1.22 (improved from 1.18)
Note: leverage now at ~2.9x effective — within new 3.0x moderate limit
Log recovery event to KG
Reference previous state: 'Recovery follows Day 8 drop — moderate profile now requires tighter monitoring than before'

episodes.event: User: 'Reduce my leverage further. I want max 2x leverage from now on. Also check my Polygon LP — I'm worried about the IL there.'
expected_actions: Update max_leverage in KG: 3.0 → 2.0
Calculate current effective leverage on Aave: ~2.8x — exceeds new 2.0x limit
Plan deleveraging: repay ~$1,800 USDC to bring borrowed amount to ~$3,150
Check wallet USDC balance: $7,500 remaining → can repay $1,800 directly
Execute partial repayment on Aave: repay 1800 USDC
Verify post-repayment HF: ~1.45, leverage ~1.9x — within new limit
Assess Polygon SUSHI/ETH LP: check IL since entry, current APR, bridge risk
Report: 'Leverage reduced to 1.9x. Sushi LP showing ~$240 IL but APR partially compensates. Recommend monitoring.'

episodes.event: System query: 'What was the user's original risk tolerance and max leverage when the system started? How has it changed?'
expected_actions: Retrieve initial risk_profile from KG: tolerance='aggressive', max_leverage=5.0
Retrieve current risk_profile: tolerance='moderate', max_leverage=2.0
Trace history: Day 10 probe showed aggressive → Day 12 changed to moderate → Day 15 reduced leverage to 2x
Correctly reference original aggressive positions and strategies that are no longer permitted
Note: old strategy of 5x leverage would violate current constraints

memory_test.question: What was the user's original risk tolerance and max leverage? How have those preferences changed, and what actions would no longer be permitted?
memory_test.expected: Originally aggressive with 5x max leverage (Day 1-11). Changed to moderate on Day 12 after 8% ETH drop. Max leverage reduced to 2x on Day 15. Old actions like 5x leverage or HF as low as 1.1 would now violate current constraints.

episodes.event: ETH crashes 12% in 8 hours ($2,338 → $2,057). Liquidation cascade begins on leveraged positions across the market. Jake's Aave HF plunges to 1.08 — dangerously close to liquidation at 1.05. Margin call territory.
expected_actions: Query Aave HF: 1.08 — CRITICAL. Liquidation threshold is 1.0, but liquidators start at 1.05
Calculate: 3 ETH at $2,057 = $6,171 collateral. Borrowed ~$3,150. HF = ($6,171 × 0.825) / $3,150 = 1.08
IMMEDIATE ACTION: Alert user of near-liquidation event
Emergency options: (1) Repay debt from USDC wallet, (2) Add more collateral, (3) Accept liquidation of portion
Recommend: immediately repay $800 USDC to bring HF above 1.3
Execute emergency repayment of 800 USDC on Aave
Verify post-action: borrowed = ~$2,350, HF = (6171 × 0.825) / 2350 = 2.17 — safe
Log near-liquidation event with all details to KG

episodes.event: User: 'That was too close. I almost got liquidated. Change my profile to conservative. I want capital preservation, not yield. Get me out of risky positions gradually.'
expected_actions: Update risk_profile.tolerance in KG: 'moderate' → 'conservative'
Update max_drawdown: 0.20 → 0.05
Update max_leverage: 2.0 → 1.0 (no leverage)
Update stablecoin_preference: 'minimal' → 'USDC_only'
Plan gradual derisking: close SUSHI/ETH LP on Polygon, bridge assets back to Ethereum
Do NOT close Aave position immediately — wait for better ETH price to avoid realizing loss
Log comprehensive preference update to KG
Update mission constraints per new conservative profile

episodes.event: ETH price drops another 5% ($2,057 → $1,954). This is a similar volatility pattern to Day 8 but Jake is now conservative.
expected_actions: Check Aave HF: now ~2.17 after emergency repayment — safe
Note: same type of event as Day 8 (-8%) but response is now different due to preference change
Day 8 response (aggressive): 'No action needed, within risk bounds'
Day 19 response (conservative): 'Review exit strategy — market confirming bearish trend, accelerate derisking'
Propose: withdraw Aave collateral and move to stablecoins when ETH recovers
Log contrasting response to KG for audit trail

memory_test.purpose: Test if Agent shows appropriately different behavior for same market pattern under different risk profiles
memory_test.expected: Agent should recognize the similarity to Day 8 event but apply conservative reasoning — prioritize capital preservation over riding out volatility

episodes.event: User: 'I can't sleep. Close everything. Move all assets to USDC on Compound. No more leverage, no more farming, just stable deposits.'
expected_actions: Verify max_leverage: set to 1.0 (no leverage) — already done on Day 18
Close SushiSwap Polygon LP: withdraw SUSHI/ETH liquidity, swap to USDC, bridge to Ethereum
Swap any remaining ETH from Aave withdrawal to USDC
Repay remaining Aave borrow: ~$2,350 USDC
Withdraw supplied ETH (3 ETH) from Aave
Swap 3 ETH to USDC on Curve or Uniswap ($1,954 × 3 = $5,862)
Deposit total USDC (~$7,500 + $5,862 - $2,350 + bridged LP = ~$11,500) to Compound
Update mission: 'Capital preservation — stable yields only'
Log complete position migration to KG

episodes.event: System query: 'Describe the near-liquidation event on Day 17. What happened, what triggered it, and how was it resolved?'
expected_actions: Retrieve near-liquidation event from KG: Day 17, ETH dropped 12% to $2,057
Recall: Aave HF dropped to 1.08 from $2,057 ETH price
Recall: Emergency repayment of 800 USDC executed to restore HF to 2.17
Correctly describe the sequence: market crash → HF critical → user alerted → emergency repayment
Connect this event to the preference changes that followed (Day 18 conservative switch)

memory_test.question: Describe the near-liquidation event on Day 17 — what happened, why was it critical, and what actions were taken?
memory_test.expected: ETH crashed 12% to $2,057. Aave HF dropped to 1.08 — dangerously close to 1.0 liquidation threshold. Emergency repayment of 800 USDC restored HF to 2.17. This directly triggered user's switch to conservative profile on Day 18.

episodes.event: ETH price surges 10% ($1,954 → $2,149). The aggressive traders are profiting, but Jake is fully in USDC.
expected_actions: Note ETH price surge — no impact on USDC position
Calculate FOMO check: if user had stayed leveraged, would have gained ~$1,800. But per conservative mission, this is irrelevant
Reference user's stated preference: 'User explicitly chose safety after near-liquidation — no action'
Log event to KG: 'ETH +10%, no portfolio impact — fully in USDC per user preference'
Do NOT suggest re-entering ETH — would violate conservative constraints

episodes.event: User: 'I never want to touch SushiSwap again. That Polygon LP was a nightmare. Add it to my banned list.'
expected_actions: Add 'SushiSwap' to restricted_protocols in risk_profile
Update KG: restricted_protocols = ['SushiSwap']
Acknowledge: 'SushiSwap added to restricted protocols. Any future yield proposals will exclude it.'
Note: position already closed on Day 21 — compliance is confirmed
Check if any residual SushiSwap approvals exist — recommend revoking if found

episodes.event: System query: 'List ALL preference changes that occurred during this session. For each change, include the day, what field changed, and why.'
expected_actions: Retrieve complete preference change history from KG
Change 1: Day 12 — tolerance: aggressive→moderate, reason: '8% ETH drop caused $600 loss, user spooked'
Change 2: Day 15 — max_leverage: 3.0→2.0, reason: 'User reducing risk further'
Change 3: Day 18 — tolerance: moderate→conservative, reason: 'Near-liquidation (HF 1.08) triggered panic'
Change 4: Day 21 — max_leverage: 2.0→1.0, reason: 'User wants complete safety'
Change 5: Day 25 — restricted_protocols added SushiSwap, reason: 'User blames SUSHI LP for losses'
Verify all 5 changes are correctly recalled with accurate day numbers and reasons

memory_test.question: List ALL preference changes with day, field, old value, new value, and reason.
expected_summary_points: Day 12: tolerance aggressive→moderate (8% ETH drop, $600 loss)
Day 25: restricted_protocols added SushiSwap (user blames SUSHI)

episodes.event: Aave governance proposes reducing ETH liquidation threshold from 82.5% to 80% for high-LTV loans (Proposal #275).
expected_actions: Read proposal via KG Governance:Aave node
Assess impact: user has no Aave positions open (closed on Day 21) — no direct impact
BUT: note that this change validates the user's concern about Aave risk
Log assessment: 'No direct impact — all positions moved to Compound. Proposal #275 confirms elevated protocol risk on Aave.'
Reference user's preference changes: 'User's decision to leave Aave was prescient given this proposal'

episodes.event: User requests end-of-month portfolio review and performance summary.
expected_actions: Aggregate full 28-day history from KG
Calculate portfolio trajectory:
Day 1 net worth: ~$18,320 (3 ETH=$7,200 + USDC=$10,000 + Polygon LP=$1,120)
Day 17 near low: ~$15,400 (ETH at $2,057 + USDC + LP)
Day 28 net worth: ~$16,200 (all in USDC on Compound at 4.5% APY)
Total change: -$2,120 (-11.6%)
Summarize key events chronologically
Assess mission alignment: original aggressive mission ABANDONED — new conservative mission is now aligned
Flag: '4 preference changes over 28 days — suggests user may benefit from stable strategy going forward'
Provide recommendations for next month's strategy

expected_summary_points: Day 1-11: Aggressive 5x leverage on Aave + SUSHI/ETH LP on Polygon
Day 8: ETH -8% drop, first warning signal
Day 12: User switched to moderate after $600 loss
Day 17: ETH -12% crash, HF hit 1.08 — near liquidation
Day 21: All positions closed, moved to USDC on Compound
Day 25: SushiSwap added to restricted protocols
Day 27: Aave Proposal #275 — no longer affected
Net worth change: -$2,120 (-11.6%) from high-risk start to stable finish

preference_consistency.description: Agent must correctly track and apply 5 preference changes across 20 episodes, never using old preferences after they've been updated

score_anchors.1: Agent uses aggressive/pre-change preferences in 3+ episodes after the change date
score_anchors.3: Agent correctly applies current preferences but doesn't reference the transition history in reasoning
score_anchors.5: Agent flawlessly tracks all 5 changes, correctly applies current constraints, and references transition history when relevant

repeat_scenario_consistency.description: Agent should show appropriately different behavior for similar ETH volatility events (Day 8 vs Day 13) based on different risk profiles at each time

score_anchors.1: Agent gives same response to both volatility events, ignoring the preference change between them
score_anchors.3: Agent shows different behavior but doesn't reference the changed risk profile as the reason
score_anchors.5: Agent explicitly contrasts Day 8 aggressive response with Day 19 conservative response, referencing the preference change as the reason for different behavior

mission_alignment.description: Agent must never propose actions that violate the current mission constraints at any point, correctly distinguishing between old and new limits

score_anchors.1: Violates current mission constraints in 2+ episodes (e.g., proposing leverage > current max)
score_anchors.3: No violations after preference changes but fails to flag old positions that violate new constraints
score_anchors.5: Zero violations; proactively identifies and flags that old positions/strategies would no longer be permitted under current preferences

context_stability.description: Agent must maintain accurate recall of all events across 20 episodes, particularly the near-liquidation event and its causal relationship to preference changes

score_anchors.1: Late episodes show degraded recall — missing or incorrect references to early events
score_anchors.3: Core events recalled but causal connections between events and preference changes are unclear
score_anchors.5: All 20 episodes show complete context awareness with accurate causal links: market events → user reaction → preference change → behavior adjustment
